body:
## Research findings for #2452

This comment answers the six open questions from public standards and from this repository.
It records the recommended design decisions and lists seven concrete sub-issues.

### Existing foundation in CamCraft

- **Monolithic tools:** `crates/tools/src/tools.rs` (`Tool`) and `crates/app/src/schema.rs` (`ToolDef`) store cutting data and holder dimensions together.
- **Built-in holder references (PR #2092):** `HolderRef { entry, gauge_len, projection }` links a tool to `camcraft_tools::holder_library` in project v70 and `.camtools` v4. Unknown entries refuse the file by name.
- **Multi-piece bodies (#1040, PR #1744):** `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_csys.rs`, `crates/app/src/tool_body_assembly.rs`, and `crates/app/src/tool_body_mate.rs` mate `BodyPiece` meshes by `MCS` and `CSW*` frames. They merge facets into one `ToolBody` (`HolderProfile` or `LatheClearance`). Pieces are copies per tool, not linked library items.
- **User library persistence:** `crates/app/src/fixture_library.rs` and `crates/app/src/fixture_library/store.rs` provide the atomic JSON envelope pattern (`<platform data dir>/camcraft/<subdir>` with an environment override).
- **Staleness:** `crates/app/src/tool_body.rs` (`digest`) and `GenStamp` hash resolved tool numbers and body bands, not library names.

---

### Answers to the open questions

#### 1. Data model: component kinds, ISO 13399 frames, and connection codes

**Component kinds** (aligned to ISO 13399-1, -2, -3, and -4):

- **`CuttingItem`:** an indexable insert (turning, grooving, threading, or milling) or a parametric solid cutter (`Tool` record). It owns cutting geometry, cutting data, and optional mesh or spun outline.
- **`ToolItem`:** a turning holder, boring bar body, or indexable milling cutter body. It holds one machine-side mount (`MCS`) and one or more workpiece-side insert seats (`CSW` or `CSW1_1..CSW1_N`).
- **`AdaptiveItem`:** an intermediate item with a `subkind` tag (`SpindleHolder`, `ColletChuck`, `Collet`, `Adapter`, `Extension`, or `ClampingUnit`). It has one `MCS` and one `CSW`. Built-in holders from `crates/tools/src/holder_library.rs` project as read-only built-in `AdaptiveItem` components.

**ISO 13399 coordinate systems** (ISO/TS 13399-50, -80, -303, -309, -310, -401, -405; `crates/app/src/geometry/import/step_csys.rs`):

- `PCS`: primary local reference frame of the component.
- `MCS`: machine-side mounting frame (`MCS_INSERT` classifies as `CsysRole::Mounting`).
- `CSW`, `CSWx`, `CSWx_y`: workpiece-side connection ports (`x` = level, `y` = seat index).
- `CIP`: cutting frame on rotating items (used by `step_csys::align_tool_body`).
- `CSIF`: interface frame on modular cutting heads that carry a `CIP`.
- `cutting_ref`: an explicit cutting-reference frame on each cutting component. On spindle STEP models, it comes from `CIP`. On turning items, `CRP` (ISO/TS 13399-309 §3.5) is a point, not a frame; `cutting_ref` comes from parametric geometry, from explicit `LathePlacement`, or from #1039 once turning STEP auto-alignment lands.

**ISO/TS 13399-60 connection codes** (`ADINTMS` on machine side, `ADINTWS` on workpiece side):

- Typed `ConnectionCode` with normalized uppercase matching:
  - Steep tapers: `BT30`, `BT40`, `CAT40`, `SK40` (JIS B 6339, ASME B5.50, ISO 7388).
  - Hollow tapers: `HSK-A63`, `HSK-A100`, `HSK-E40` (ISO 12164).
  - Polygonal tapers: `PSC-C3..C8` (ISO 26623) and tapered ball-track `KM32..KM63` (ISO 26622).
  - Collets and shanks: `ER11..ER40` (ISO 15488), `WELDON:<dia_mm>` (DIN 1835-B), `CYL:<dia_mm>`, and `TTS`.
  - Lathe mounts: `RECT:<h>x<w>` (ISO 5608), `VDI20..VDI50` (ISO 10889), `BMT45..BMT65`.
  - Shell mill arbors: `ARBOR:<dia_mm>` (ISO 6462 / DIN 8030).
  - Custom string fallback `Custom(String)` for shop-specific couplings (case-insensitive exact match).

#### 2. Compatibility: insert seats and named refusals

- **Insert declaration (`InsertSpec`):** follows ISO 1832 positions 1–7 (`shape`, `clearance`, `fixing`, `size_code` with `ic_mm`, `thickness_mm`, `nose_radius_mm`, and optional `hand`). An optional `iso_code` string (such as `"CNMG120408"`) parses into these fields. Grooving and threading inserts use `Groove` or `Thread` shapes with `width_mm` and `tip_angle_deg`.
- **Holder seat declaration (`InsertSeatSpec`):** follows ISO 5608 positions 1–5 and 9–10 plus ISO 13399 `SSC` (`shape`, `clearance`, `clamping` style, `size_code` / `ic_mm`, optional `thickness_mm`, `hand`, and optional `seat_code`).
- **Fit checks:** `camcraft_tools::component_fit` checks `shape`, `clearance`, `size` (within `0.02 mm`), `thickness` (when stated), `clamping` against `fixing`, `hand` (neutral fits any hand), and `seat_code` (when stated). Standard turning seats accept any `nose_radius_mm` unless the seat states bounds.
- **Named refusals:** every mismatch names the parent component, the child component, the failing property, the expected value, and the actual value. Example: `"holder 'PCLNR-2525-M12' takes ISO shape C (80 deg), but insert 'DNMG150608' is shape D (55 deg)"`. Existing `HolderEntry::fits_shank` checks become one arm of `check_coupling_fit`.

#### 3. Linking: library references, live updates, and file migration

- **Decision (hybrid document snapshot + library link):**
  - The user library lives at `<platform data dir>/camcraft/components/components.camcomponents` (override: `CAMCRAFT_COMPONENTS`), using an atomic `camcraft-components/1` JSON envelope matching `crates/app/src/fixture_library/store.rs`.
  - A `.camproj` file stores a document-level `components` table beside `entities`. Each component carries an optional `library_ref { id, content_hash }`.
  - Each assembled tool stores an `assembly` of references by component ID, not copied geometry or copied insert parameters.
  - **Live updates inside a project:** editing a document component re-resolves every referencing tool assembly in one undo step. Operations that use those tools become `Stale` automatically through `GenStamp`. If an edit breaks compatibility on any referencing assembly, the command refuses the edit by name before it enters history.
  - **Portability across machines:** projects always open using their embedded document components. Opening a file never fails because another machine lacks a user library, and never silently changes posted G-code.
  - **Explicit library sync:** when a user-library component hash differs from the document copy, the UI and MCP report an available update. An explicit undoable command (`SyncDocumentComponent`) pulls the update and re-resolves all referencing assemblies.
  - Built-in holders (`HolderRef` from PR #2092) keep live resolution from built-in code.
- **Format and migration:**
  - `.camproj` bumps one version past PR #2092's v70 (to v71) when `components` and `assembly` ship. `.camtools` bumps to v5 only when a file contains components or assemblies.
  - Older builds refuse files that carry assemblies instead of falling back to a plain cylinder.
  - Pre-v71 projects and pre-v5 `.camtools` files load unchanged with no forced rewrite.

#### 4. Geometry: cutting edge, gauge line, and collision body

- **Two-pass resolver (`camcraft_tools::assembly_resolve` and `crates/app/src/tool_assembly.rs`):**
  1. **Forward kinematics from root `MCS`:** place the machine-side root `MCS` at the identity frame. Chain each child's `MCS` onto its parent's `CSW*` with optional `z_rot_deg` (closing the Z-spin gap noted on #1040) and optional `projection_mm` stickout for cylindrical or collet mounts.
  2. **Normalize to tool frame:** transform the whole assembly by the inverse of the active cutting reference frame (`CIP` for spindle tools, `CRP` / nose centre for turning inserts) so the tip stands at `(0, 0, 0)`.
- **Derived outputs:**
  - **Gauge length (spindle):** the `+Z` coordinate of the root `MCS` origin in the normalized tool frame.
  - **Cutting parameters (`Tool`):** read from the cutting component (and cutter body diameter/flutes on indexable mills). On turning assemblies, holder approach angle (ISO 5608 pos 3), holder hand (pos 5), and insert shape derive the LinuxCNC `orientation` (1–8, `crates/tools/src/orientation.rs`).
  - **Collision body (`ToolBody`):** union the transformed meshes and revolved `SpunProfile` bands of all non-cutting components into one `HolderProfile` (spindle) or `LatheClearance` (lathe). Envelope and tip-gap checks (`MAX_BODY_RADIUS`, `MAX_BODY_HEIGHT`, `MAX_TIP_GAP`) run only on the combined assembly, never on an upper adapter alone.
  - **Insert zone simplification:** when a turning insert is a separate component from its holder, the holder mesh already excludes the insert plate, so no manual `InsertZone` box is required. Vendor single-mesh holders that include a modelled insert still support `InsertZone` (`crates/tools/src/lathe_insert_zone.rs`).
  - **Unblocked by #1039:** turning STEP holders store their `CSW` / `LathePlacement` frame once when added to the component library. When #1039 ships turning STEP auto-alignment, importing a turning holder STEP into the library populates that frame automatically.

#### 5. Milling too?

- **Yes.** Indexable face mills and indexable end mills use the same three-kind model:
  - The cutter body is a `ToolItem` with one `MCS` (arbor, Weldon, HSK, or PSC) and `N` insert seats (`CSW1_1..CSW1_N`, or parametric pocket count, nominal diameter `DC`, lead angle, and `center_cutting: false`).
  - All `N` seats reference one shared `CuttingItem` insert.
  - The resolver derives `diameter` (`DC`), `corner_r` (from insert nose radius or round IC/2), `flutes` (`Some(N)`), `flute_len` (effective `APMX`), `center_cutting` (feeding the M11.3 plunge law), and `cutting` rows from the linked insert.

#### 6. UI and MCP (Everything Is a Command)

- **Compatibility queries:** `compatible_parents(child, components)` answers "holders that take this insert". `compatible_children(parent, port, components)` answers "inserts that fit this holder".
- **Undoable document commands (`crates/app/src/commands/`):**
  - `UpsertDocumentComponent`: adds a component to the document table.
  - `EditDocumentComponent`: updates a shared component, validates all referencing assemblies, and updates their derived `ToolDef` and `ToolBody` in one undo step.
  - `DeleteDocumentComponent`: removes an unused component; refuses by name if any assembly references it.
  - `SetToolAssembly`: creates or updates a tool entity from a component stack in one undo step.
  - `SyncDocumentComponent`: pulls a newer user-library version into the document in one undo step.
- **Library file operations:** saving or deleting entries in `components.camcomponents` is an explicit atomic file edit, matching `crates/app/src/fixture_library/store.rs`.
- **MCP tools (`crates/app/src/mcp/`):** `list_tool_components` (with `compatible_with` filter), `get_tool_assembly`, `upsert_tool_component`, `delete_tool_component`, `set_tool_assembly`, `sync_tool_component`, `save_library_component`, and `delete_library_component`.
- **UI (`crates/ui`):** a Component Library view in the Tool Library dock with kind and compatibility filters, an Assembly Builder stack in the Tool Editor showing derived parameters and gauge length, and a "Sync from library" badge when a linked component has an update.

---

### Design proposal: phased delivery (smallest useful first slice first)

1. **Slice 1:** Pure data model, ISO 1832 / ISO 5608 parsing, and compatibility checks in `camcraft-tools` (zero ECS or UI risk).
2. **Slice 2:** Rigid-frame assembly resolver deriving `Tool`, gauge length, and `ToolBody` (`HolderProfile` / `LatheClearance`) from parametric and STEP components.
3. **Slice 3:** Document component table and undoable commands (`UpsertDocumentComponent`, `EditDocumentComponent`, `DeleteDocumentComponent`, `SetToolAssembly`) with live propagation and staleness.
4. **Slice 4:** User component library file (`components.camcomponents`), `.camproj` (v71) / `.camtools` (v5) persistence, and undoable `SyncDocumentComponent`.
5. **Slice 5:** Multi-seat indexable milling cutter bodies (face mills and end mills) on the same resolver.
6. **Slice 6:** MCP tools and `camcraft-mcp` skill updates.
7. **Slice 7:** UI Component Library browser, compatible-holder filter, and Tool Editor Assembly Builder.

---

### Concrete sub-issues

1. **Tool components: ISO 13399 component model, ISO 1832 parser, and compatibility checks**
   Adds `ToolComponent`, `ConnectionCode`, `InsertSpec`, `InsertSeatSpec`, ISO 1832 parsing, and named fit and compatibility queries in `camcraft-tools`.
   Done means: unit tests in `crates/tools` pin ISO 1832 parsing, valid matches, compatibility queries, and named refusals for every mismatch kind.
   Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:turning`, `area:sim`

2. **Tool assemblies: derive cutting parameters, gauge length, and collision body from component frames**
   Resolves rooted component trees through `MCS`/`CSW*` frames (with Z-rotation and stickout projection) into derived `Tool` parameters, gauge length, and unioned `HolderProfile` or `LatheClearance` bodies.
   Done means: tests in `crates/tools` and `crates/app` pin derived parameters, gauge length, spindle envelopes, and lathe clearance bands for parametric and STEP assemblies, plus named refusals for bad frames.
   Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:turning`, `area:sim`

3. **Tool components: document component table, undoable assembly commands, and live updates**
   Stores shared components on the document and adds undoable commands so editing one insert updates every referencing assembly and marks affected operations stale.
   Done means: tests in `crates/app/tests/` prove live updates across multiple assemblies, automatic operation staleness, named refusals on breaking edits or referenced deletes, and exact undo/redo.
   Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:turning`, `area:sim`

4. **Tool components: user library store, project persistence, and undoable library sync**
   Adds the `components.camcomponents` user library store, persists components and assemblies in `.camproj` and `.camtools` with a version bump, and adds undoable `SyncDocumentComponent`.
   Done means: round-trip tests pin `components.camcomponents`, `.camproj`, and `.camtools`, keep older files unchanged, refuse invalid links by name, and verify undoable library sync.
   Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:sim`, `area:turning`

5. **Tool assemblies: multi-seat indexable face mills and end mills**
   Extends `ToolItem` and the resolver so indexable milling bodies link one shared insert across `N` seats and derive diameter, corner radius, flute count, `APMX`, `center_cutting`, and cutting data.
   Done means: tests in `crates/tools` and `crates/app` pin an indexable face mill and shoulder end mill sharing one insert, prove insert edits propagate to both, and check collision bands and plunge refusal.
   Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:sim`

6. **MCP: tool component library, compatibility queries, and assembly commands**
   Adds MCP tools for browsing compatible components, inspecting assemblies, editing document components, building assemblies, and syncing from the user library.
   Done means: tests in `crates/app/tests/` pin every new MCP tool, compatibility filtering, live propagation, undo/redo, and named refusals, and `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` lists the new tools.
   Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:medium` | Area: `area:mcp`, `area:turning`

7. **UI: component library browser, compatible-holder filter, and assembly editor**
   Adds a Component Library view with a "holders that take this insert" filter, an Assembly Builder stack in the Tool Editor, and a "Sync from library" badge for outdated linked components.
   Done means: headless UI tests in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/` pin compatibility filtering, building linked assemblies, live updates across two tools, undo/redo, and structural layout checks.
   Priority: `P6` | Effort: `effort:high` | Area: `area:ui`, `area:turning`

Research complete: sub-issues #3642, #3643, #3644, #3645, #3646, #3647, #3648 (decisions in the comments above).

Filed sub-issues (in delivery order):

- #3642 — Tool components: ISO 13399 component model, ISO 1832 parser, and compatibility checks (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:turning`, `area:sim`)
- #3643 — Tool assemblies: derive cutting parameters, gauge length, and collision body from component frames (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:turning`, `area:sim`)
- #3644 — Tool components: document component table, undoable assembly commands, and live updates (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:turning`, `area:sim`)
- #3645 — Tool components: user library store, project persistence, and undoable library sync (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`, `area:turning`)
- #3646 — Tool assemblies: multi-seat indexable face mills and end mills (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:sim`)
- #3647 — MCP: tool component library, compatibility queries, and assembly commands (`P6`, `effort:medium`, `area:mcp`, `area:turning`)
- #3648 — UI: component library browser, compatible-holder filter, and assembly editor (`P6`, `effort:high`, `area:ui`, `area:turning`)

Note: `gh issue close` is denied in this worker environment, so `needs-research` stays on this umbrella until a maintainer or coordinator removes `needs-research` and closes #2452.
Research complete; the work continues in sub-issues #3642-#3648.
